verses.en: Verily, thus saith the Lord unto you, my servant Joseph Smith, I am well pleased with your offering and acknowledgments, which you have made; for unto this end have I raised you up, that I might show forth my wisdom through the weak things of the earth.
verses.sm: E moni, ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii ia te oe, la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, ua Ou fiafia lava i lau taulaga ma au tautinoga, ua e faia; ona o le faamoemoe lea na Ou faatuina mai ai oe, ina ia Ou faailoa atu lo’u poto e ala i mea vaivai o le lalolagi.

verses.en: Your prayers are acceptable before me; and in answer to them I say unto you, that you are now called immediately to make a solemn proclamation of my gospel, and of this stake which I have planted to be a cornerstone of Zion, which shall be polished with the refinement which is after the similitude of a palace.
verses.sm: Ua talia au tatalo i o’u luma; ma i le tali atu i au tatalo Ou te fai atu ai ia te oe, ua valaaulia vave nei oe e faia se folafolaga aloaia o la’u talalelei, ma o le siteki lenei ua Ou faatuina e avea ma maatulimanu o Siona, lea o le a faaiila i teuga matagofie e tusa ma foliga o se maota o se tupu.

verses.en: This proclamation shall be made to all the kings of the world, to the four corners thereof, to the honorable president-elect, and the high-minded governors of the nation in which you live, and to all the nations of the earth scattered abroad.
verses.sm: Ia fai atu lenei folafolaga i tupu uma o le lalolagi, i ona tulimanu e fa, i le peresitene mamalu filifilia, ma kovana faitōfā o le atunuu ua e nofo ai, ma i atunuu uma ua salalau i le lalolagi.

verses.en: Let it be written in the spirit of meekness and by the power of the Holy Ghost, which shall be in you at the time of the writing of the same;
verses.sm: Ia tusia i le agaga o le agamalu ma i le mana o le Agaga Paia, lea o le a ia te oe i le taimi e tusia ai lea lava folafolaga;

verses.en: For it shall be given you by the Holy Ghost to know my will concerning those kings and authorities, even what shall befall them in a time to come.
verses.sm: Aua o le a tuuina atu ia te oe e le Agaga Paia ia e iloa lo’u loto e uiga i tupu ma pule na, e oo lava i mea o le a pa’u’ū ai i latou i se taimi o le a oo mai.

verses.en: For, behold, I am about to call upon them to give heed to the light and glory of Zion, for the set time has come to favor her.
verses.sm: Aua, faauta, ua lata ona Ou valaau atu ia i latou ia ua’i mai i le malamalama ma le mamalu o Siona, aua ua oo mai le taimi atofaina e faapitoa ai Siona.

verses.en: Call ye, therefore, upon them with loud proclamation, and with your testimony, fearing them not, for they are as grass, and all their glory as the flower thereof which soon falleth, that they may be left also without excuse—
verses.sm: O lea, ia e valaau atu ai, ia te i latou i le folafolaga leotele, faatasi ma lau molimau, ma ia e lē mata’u ia i latou, ona ua pei i latou o le vao, ma o lo latou mamalu atoa ua faapei o lona fuga ua lata ona pa’ū, ma ina ia tuua ai foi i latou e aunoa ma se ’alofaga—

verses.en: And that I may visit them in the day of visitation, when I shall unveil the face of my covering, to appoint the portion of the oppressor among hypocrites, where there is gnashing of teeth, if they reject my servants and my testimony which I have revealed unto them.
verses.sm: Ma ia mafai ona Ou asiasi atu ia te i latou i le aso o le asiasiga, pe a Ou afe le ufiufi o o’u mata, e tofi atu le vaega a le faasauā faatasi ma e pepelo, i le mea e i ai le lilivau o nifo, pe afai latou te teena a’u auauna ma la’u molimau ua Ou faaalia atu ia te i latou.

verses.en: And again, I will visit and soften their hearts, many of them for your good, that ye may find grace in their eyes, that they may come to the light of truth, and the Gentiles to the exaltation or lifting up of Zion.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o le a Ou asiasi atu ma faamalulu o latou loto, le toatele lea o i latou, mo lo outou lelei, ina ia outou maua le alofa tunoa i la latou vaai, ina ia mafai ona latou o mai i le malamalama o le upumoni, ma Nuuese i le faaeaga po o le siitiaina a’e i luga o Siona.

verses.en: For the day of my visitation cometh speedily, in an hour when ye think not of; and where shall be the safety of my people, and refuge for those who shall be left of them?
verses.sm: Ona ua vave ona oo mai o le aso o la’u asiasiga, i se itula tou te lē mafaufau i ai; ma o fea o le a i ai le saogalemu o lo’u nuu, ma le sulufaiga mo i latou o e o le a tuua?

verses.en: Awake, O kings of the earth! Come ye, O, come ye, with your gold and your silver, to the help of my people, to the house of the daughters of Zion.
verses.sm: Ala mai ia, E, tupu e o le lalolagi! Ia outou o mai ia, E, ia outou o mai ia, ma a outou auro ma a outou ario, e fesoasoani i lo’u nuu, i le fale o afafine o Siona.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, let my servant Robert B. Thompson help you to write this proclamation, for I am well pleased with him, and that he should be with you;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te oe, tuu atu i la’u auauna o Robert B. Thompson e fesoasoani ia te oe e tusi lenei folafolaga, ona ua Ou fiafia lava ia te ia, ma e tatau ona faatasi o ia ma oe;

verses.en: Let him, therefore, hearken to your counsel, and I will bless him with a multiplicity of blessings; let him be faithful and true in all things from henceforth, and he shall be great in mine eyes;
verses.sm: O lea, ia tuu atu ia te ia ’ia faalogo i lau fautuaga, ma o le a Ou faamanuiaina o ia i faamanuiaga e tele; ia tuu atu ia te ia ’ia faamaoni ma tonu i mea uma mai le taimi nei ma le agai i luma, ma o le a sili o ia i la’u vaai;

verses.en: But let him remember that his stewardship will I require at his hands.
verses.sm: Ae ia tuu atu ia te ia ’ia manatua e ia o le a Ou manaomia mai lona lima lana mea-tausi.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, blessed is my servant Hyrum Smith; for I, the Lord, love him because of the integrity of his heart, and because he loveth that which is right before me, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te oe, amuia lava la’u auauna o Ailama Samita; aua o A’u, o le Alii, ua alofa ia te ia ona o le faamaoni o lona loto, ma ona e fiafia o ia i mea ua sa’o i o’u luma, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

verses.en: Again, let my servant John C. Bennett help you in your labor in sending my word to the kings and people of the earth, and stand by you, even you my servant Joseph Smith, in the hour of affliction; and his reward shall not fail if he receive counsel.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, tuu atu i la’u auauna o John C. Bennett e fesoasoani ia te oe i lau galuega i le auina atu o la’u upu i tupu ma tagata o le lalolagi, ma tulai i ou tafatafa, la’u auauna lava lea o Iosefa Samita, i le itula o le puapuaga; ma o le a lē i’uvale lona taui pe afai e talia e ia fautuaga.

verses.en: And for his love he shall be great, for he shall be mine if he do this, saith the Lord. I have seen the work which he hath done, which I accept if he continue, and will crown him with blessings and great glory.
verses.sm: Ma o le a sili tele atu o ia ona o lona alofa, aua o le a avea o ia mo’u pe afai e faia e ia lenei mea, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii. Ua Ou vaai i le galuega na ia faia, lea Ou te talia pe afai e faaauau pea o ia, ma faapaleina o ia i faamanuiaga ma le mamalu tele.

verses.en: And again, I say unto you that it is my will that my servant Lyman Wight should continue in preaching for Zion, in the spirit of meekness, confessing me before the world; and I will bear him up as on eagles' wings; and he shall beget glory and honor to himself and unto my name.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, o lo’u loto e tatau i la’u auauna o Lyman Wight ona faaauau pea ona talai atu mo Siona, i le agaga o le agamalu, ma ta’uta’u atu a’u i luma o le lalolagi; ma o le a Ou sapasapaia o ia i luga e pei o i luga o apaau o aeto; ma o le a aumai e ia le mamalu ma le viiga ia te ia lava ma i lo’u igoa.

verses.en: That when he shall finish his work I may receive him unto myself, even as I did my servant David Patten, who is with me at this time, and also my servant Edward Partridge, and also my aged servant Joseph Smith, Sen., who sitteth with Abraham at his right hand, and blessed and holy is he, for he is mine.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona Ou avea o ia mo a’u lava pe a faai’uina e ia lana galuega, e pei ona Ou faia i la’u auauna o David Patten, lē ua faatasi nei ma a’u, ma la’u auauna foi o Edward Partridge, ma la’u auauna matua foi o Iosefa Samitale Matua, lē ua nonofo faatasi ma Aperaamo i lona lima taumatau, ma ua faamanuiaina lava ma paia o ia, ona ua ā a’u o ia.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, my servant George Miller is without guile; he may be trusted because of the integrity of his heart; and for the love which he has to my testimony I, the Lord, love him.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te oe, o la’u auauna o George Miller, ua aunoa ma le faa’ole’ole; e mafai ona faalagolagoina o ia ona o le faamaoni o lona loto; ma ona o le alofa ua ia te ia i la’u molimau, o A’u, o le Alii, ua alofa ia te ia.

verses.en: I therefore say unto you, I seal upon his head the office of a bishopric, like unto my servant Edward Partridge, that he may receive the consecrations of mine house, that he may administer blessings upon the heads of the poor of my people, saith the Lord. Let no man despise my servant George, for he shall honor me.
verses.sm: O lea Ou te fai atu ai ia te oe, Ou te faamauina i luga o lona ulu le tofi o se au epikopo, e pei o la’u auauna o Edward Partridge, ina ia maua e ia faapaiaga o lo’u fale, ina ia mafai e ia ona tuu atu faamanuiaga i luga o ulu o e matitiva o lo’u nuu, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii. Ia lē tuu atu i se tagata ia inoino i la’u auauna o George, ona o le a faamamaluina a’u e ia.

verses.en: Let my servant George, and my servant Lyman, and my servant John Snider, and others, build a house unto my name, such a one as my servant Joseph shall show unto them, upon the place which he shall show unto them also.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o George, ma la’u auauna o Lyman, ma la’u auauna o John Snider, ma isi, e fausia se fale i lo’u igoa, ia pei o le fale o le a faaali atu e la’u auauna o Iosefa ia te i latou, i luga o le nofoaga o le a faaali atu foi e ia ia te i latou.

verses.en: And it shall be for a house for boarding, a house that strangers may come from afar to lodge therein; therefore let it be a good house, worthy of all acceptation, that the weary traveler may find health and safety while he shall contemplate the word of the Lord; and the cornerstone I have appointed for Zion.
verses.sm: Ma o le a avea lea fale o se fale e tali ai tagata, o se fale e mafai ona o mai i ai tagata ese mai mea mamao e nonofo ai; o lea ia avea ma se fale lelei, e agavaa mo le talia atoatoa, ina ia maua e le tagata malaga vaivai le maloloina ma le saogalemu a’o manatunatu loloto o ia i le afioga a le Alii; ma o le maatulimanu ua Ou tofia mo Siona.

verses.en: This house shall be a healthful habitation if it be built unto my name, and if the governor which shall be appointed unto it shall not suffer any pollution to come upon it. It shall be holy, or the Lord your God will not dwell therein.
verses.sm: O lenei fale o le a avea ma nofoaga o le maloloina pe afai e fausia i lo’u igoa, ma pe afai e lē tuua e le pule o le a tofia i ai se mea eleelea e oo mai i ona luga. O le a paia, po ua lē afio ai le Alii lo outou Atua.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, let all my saints come from afar.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu i la’u au paia uma e o mai i mea mamao.

verses.en: And send ye swift messengers, yea, chosen messengers, and say unto them: Come ye, with all your gold, and your silver, and your precious stones, and with all your antiquities; and with all who have knowledge of antiquities, that will come, may come, and bring the box tree, and the fir tree, and the pine tree, together with all the precious trees of the earth;
verses.sm: Ma ia outou auina atu ni avefeau televavave, ioe, ni avefeau filifilia, ma fai atu ia te i latou: Ia outou o mai ia, ma a outou auro uma, ma a outou ario, ma a outou maa taua, ma a outou mea anamua uma, ma faatasi ma i latou uma o e ua i ai le malamalama e uiga i mea anamua, o e e fia o mai, ia o mai, ma aumai le laau tasura, ma le laau perosi, ma le laau kitara, faatasi ma laau taua uma o le lalolagi;

verses.en: And with iron, with copper, and with brass, and with zinc, and with all your precious things of the earth; and build a house to my name, for the Most High to dwell therein.
verses.sm: Ma faatasi ma le uamea, ma le kopa, ma le apamemea, ma le metala pa’epa’e, faatasi ma a outou mea taua uma o le lalolagi; ma fausia se fale i lo’u igoa, mo le Silisili Ese e afio ai.

verses.en: For there is not a place found on earth that he may come to and restore again that which was lost unto you, or which he hath taken away, even the fulness of the priesthood.
verses.sm: Aua ua leai se mea e maua i le lalolagi e mafai e ia ona afio mai i ai ma toefuatai mai mea na leiloa mai ia te outou, po o mea na aveesea e ia, o le atoatoaga lava o le perisitua.

verses.en: For a baptismal font there is not upon the earth, that they, my saints, may be baptized for those who are dead—
verses.sm: Aua ua lē o i ai se faatanoa faipapatisoga i le lalolagi, e mafai ai e i latou, o la’u au paia, ona papatisoina ai mo i latou o e ua maliliu—

verses.en: For this ordinance belongeth to my house, and cannot be acceptable to me, only in the days of your poverty, wherein ye are not able to build a house unto me.
verses.sm: Aua o lenei sauniga e ā lo’u fale, ma e lē mafai ona Ou taliaina, tau lava i aso o lo outou mativa, ia e lē mafai ai ona outou fausia o se fale mo a’u.

w.en: in the days of your poverty.

verses.en: But I command you, all ye my saints, to build a house unto me; and I grant unto you a sufficient time to build a house unto me; and during this time your baptisms shall be acceptable unto me.
verses.sm: Ae ’Ou te poloai atu ia te outou, outou uma o la’u au paia, ia fausia se fale mo a’u; ma ’Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se taimi ua lava e fausia ai se fale mo a’u; ma o le taimi lea o le a talia ai a outou papatisoga ia te a’u.

verses.en: But behold, at the end of this appointment your baptisms for your dead shall not be acceptable unto me; and if you do not these things at the end of the appointment ye shall be rejected as a church, with your dead, saith the Lord your God.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, i le faaiuga o lenei taimi tuupoina o le a lē talia ia te a’u a outou papatisoga mo o outou tagata maliliu; ma afai tou te lē faia nei mea i le faaiuga o le taimi tuupoina, o le a teena outou o se ekalesia, faatasi ma o outou tagata maliliu, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua.

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, that after you have had sufficient time to build a house to me, wherein the ordinance of baptizing for the dead belongeth, and for which the same was instituted from before the foundation of the world, your baptisms for your dead cannot be acceptable unto me;
verses.sm: Aua e moni ’Ou te fai atu ia te outou, a uma ona outou maua se taimi ua lava e fausia ai se fale mo a’u, o ona totonu e i ai le sauniga o le papatisoga mo e ua maliliu, ma o mea lava ia na faatuina a o le i faavaeina le lalolagi, o le a lē mafai ona talia ia te a’u a outou papatisoga mo o outou tagata maliliu;

verses.en: For therein are the keys of the holy priesthood ordained, that you may receive honor and glory.
verses.sm: Aua o totonu iinā e faauuina ai ki o le perisitua paia, ina ia outou maua le viiga ma le mamalu.

verses.en: And after this time, your baptisms for the dead, by those who are scattered abroad, are not acceptable unto me, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma a mavae lenei taimi, o a outou papatisoga mo e ua maliliu, e faia e i latou o e ua salalau lautele, e lē talia ia te a’u, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

verses.en: For it is ordained that in Zion, and in her stakes, and in Jerusalem, those places which I have appointed for refuge, shall be the places for your baptisms for your dead.
verses.sm: Aua ua faauuina o Siona, ma i ona siteki, ma i Ierusalema, nofoaga na ua ’Ou tofia mo sulufaiga, o nofoaga na ia avea mo a outou papatisoga mo o outou tagata maliliu.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, how shall your washings be acceptable unto me, except ye perform them in a house which you have built to my name?
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni ’Ou te fai atu ia te outou, pe faapefea ona talia ia te a’u a outou mulumuluga, vagana ai ua outou faia i latou i totonu o se fale ua outou fausia mo lo’u igoa?

verses.en: For, for this cause I commanded Moses that he should build a tabernacle, that they should bear it with them in the wilderness, and to build a house in the land of promise, that those ordinances might be revealed which had been hid from before the world was.
verses.sm: Aua, o le pogai lea na ’Ou poloaiina ai Mose e tatau ia te ia ona fausia se fale fetafai, e tatau ona latou tauave faatasi ma i latou i le vao, ma ia fausia se fale i le laueleele o le folafolaga, ina ia mafai ona faaali mai ai sauniga ia na natia mai le taimi ae lei i ai le lalolagi.

verses.en: Therefore, verily I say unto you, that your anointings, and your washings, and your baptisms for the dead, and your solemn assemblies, and your memorials for your sacrifices by the sons of Levi, and for your oracles in your most holy places wherein you receive conversations, and your statutes and judgments, for the beginning of the revelations and foundation of Zion, and for the glory, honor, and endowment of all her municipals, are ordained by the ordinance of my holy house, which my people are always commanded to build unto my holy name.
verses.sm: O lea, e moni ’Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o a outou faauuga, ma a outou mulumuluga, ma a outou papatisoga mo e ua maliliu, ma a outou faapotopotoga paia, ma a outou faamanatuga mo a outou taulaga e faia e atalii o Levi, ma mo a outou faaaliga i o outou nofoaga sili ona paia ia tou te maua ai i totonu talatalaga, ma a outou tulafono ma faamasinoga, mo le amataga o faaaliga ma le faavaega o Siona, ma mo le mamalu, viiga, ma le faaeega o ona tagata uma, ua faauuina i sauniga o lo’u fale paia, lea ua poloaiina lo’u nuu i taimi uma ia fausia i lo’u igoa paia.

verses.en: And verily I say unto you, let this house be built unto my name, that I may reveal mine ordinances therein unto my people;
verses.sm: Ma e moni ’Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu ia fausia lenei fale mo lo’u igoa, ina ia mafai ona ’Ou faaali atu ai i totonu a’u sauniga i lo’u nuu;

verses.en: For I deign to reveal unto my church things which have been kept hid from before the foundation of the world, things that pertain to the dispensation of the fulness of times.
verses.sm: Aua ua ’Ou manatu ua tatau ona faaali atu i la’u ekalesia mea sa taofi natia a o le i faavaeina le lalolagi, o mea e faatatau i le tisipenisione o le ’atoaga o taimi.

verses.en: And I will show unto my servant Joseph all things pertaining to this house, and the priesthood thereof, and the place whereon it shall be built.
verses.sm: Ma o le a ’Ou faaali atu i la’u auauna o Iosefa mea uma e faatatau i lenei fale, ma lona perisitua, ma le nofoaga o le a fausia ai i luga.

verses.en: And ye shall build it on the place where you have contemplated building it, for that is the spot which I have chosen for you to build it.
verses.sm: Ma ia outou fausia i luga o le nofoaga i le mea ua outou mafaufau e fausia ai, aua o le fasi fanua lena ua Ou filifilia mo outou e fausia ai.

verses.en: If ye labor with all your might, I will consecrate that spot that it shall be made holy.
verses.sm: Afai tou te galulue ma lo outou malosi atoa, o le a Ou faapaiaina lena fasi eleele ina ia faia ia paia.

w.en: if ye labor with your might

verses.en: And if my people will hearken unto my voice, and unto the voice of my servants whom I have appointed to lead my people, behold, verily I say unto you, they shall not be moved out of their place.
verses.sm: Ma afai e faalogo mai lo’u nuu i lo’u leo, ma le leo o a’u auauna o e ua Ou tofia e taitaia lo’u nuu, faauta, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le a lē aveesea i latou mai lo latou nofoaga.

verses.en: But if they will not hearken to my voice, nor unto the voice of these men whom I have appointed, they shall not be blest, because they pollute mine holy grounds, and mine holy ordinances, and charters, and my holy words which I give unto them.
verses.sm: Ae afai latou te lē faalogo mai i lo’u leo, po o le leo o nei alii o e ua Ou tofia, o le a lē faamanuiaina i latou, aua ua latou faaeleeleaina o’u eleele paia, ma a’u sauniga paia, ma tusi faavae, ma a’u upu paia Ou te tuu atu ia te i latou.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that if you build a house unto my name, and do not do the things that I say, I will not perform the oath which I make unto you, neither fulfil the promises which ye expect at my hands, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai, afai tou te fausia se fale i lo’u igoa, ma lē faia mea Ou te fai atu ai, o le a Ou lē faia le tautoga ua Ou faia atu ia te outou, pe faataunuu folafolaga ua outou faamoemoe i ai mai lo’u lima, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

w.en: And it shall come to pass,

verses.en: For instead of blessings, ye, by your own works, bring cursings, wrath, indignation, and judgments upon your own heads, by your follies, and by all your abominations, which you practice before me, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: Aua nai lo faamanuiaga, o outou, ia outou lava galuega, tou te aumaia fetuu, le toasa, le toatamai, ma faamasinoga i luga o o outou lava ulu, e ala i o outou sese, ma ala ia outou mea inosia uma, ua outou faia i o’u luma, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that when I give a commandment to any of the sons of men to do a work unto my name, and those sons of men go with all their might and with all they have to perform that work, and cease not their diligence, and their enemies come upon them and hinder them from performing that work, behold, it behooveth me to require that work no more at the hands of those sons of men, but to accept of their offerings.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, a Ou tuuina atu se poloaiga i soo se tasi o atalii o tagata, e fai se galuega i lo’u igoa, ma o atu ia atalii o tagata ma lo latou malosi atoa ma mea uma ua ia te i latou e fai lena galuega, ma lē tuua lo latou filiga, ae o mai o latou fili ia i latou ma taofi i latou mai le faia o lena galuega, faauta, ona tatau ai lea ia te a’u ona lē toe manaomia lena galuega mai i lima o ia atalii o tagata, ae talia a latou taulaga.

verses.en: And the iniquity and transgression of my holy laws and commandments I will visit upon the heads of those who hindered my work, unto the third and fourth generation, so long as they repent not, and hate me, saith the Lord God.
verses.sm: Ma o le amioletonu ma le soliga o a’u tulafono ma poloaiga paia o le a Ou asiasi atu ai i luga o ulu o i latou o e ua ponatia ai la’u galuega, e oo atu i le tupulaga lona tolu ma le fa, i le umi latou te lē salamo ai, ma inoino mai ai ia te a’u, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii le Atua.

verses.en: Therefore, for this cause have I accepted the offerings of those whom I commanded to build up a city and a house unto my name, in Jackson county, Missouri, and were hindered by their enemies, saith the Lord your God.
verses.sm: O lea, o le pogai lenei ua Ou taliaina ai taulaga a i latou o e na Ou poloaiina e fausia se aai ma se fale i lo’u igoa, i le itumalo o Jackson, Misuri, ma sa taofia e o latou fili, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua.

verses.en: And I will answer judgment, wrath, and indignation, wailing, and anguish, and gnashing of teeth upon their heads, unto the third and fourth generation, so long as they repent not, and hate me, saith the Lord your God.
verses.sm: Ma o le a Ou tali atu i le faamasinoga, ita, ma le toasa, le tagiaue, faavauvau, ma le lilivau o nifo i luga o o latou ulu, e oo atu i le tupulaga lona tolu ma le fa, i le umi latou te lē salamo ai, ma inoino mai ia te a’u, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua.

verses.en: And this I make an example unto you, for your consolation concerning all those who have been commanded to do a work and have been hindered by the hands of their enemies, and by oppression, saith the Lord your God.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te faia lenei mea ma faataitaiga ia te outou, mo lo outou toafilemu e faatatau ia i latou uma o e na poloaiina e faia se galuega a ua ponatia e lima o o latou fili, ma i sauaga, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua.

verses.en: For I am the Lord your God, and will save all those of your brethren who have been pure in heart, and have been slain in the land of Missouri, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: Aua o A’u o le Alii lo outou Atua, ma o le a Ou laveaiina i latou uma o o outou uso o e na loto mamā, ma sa fasiotia i le laueleele o Misuri, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, I command you again to build a house to my name, even in this place, that you may prove yourselves unto me that ye are faithful in all things whatsoever I command you, that I may bless you, and crown you with honor, immortality, and eternal life.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, Ou te toe poloai atu ia te outou ia fausia se fale i lo’u igoa, i le nofoaga lava lenei, ina ia outou faamaonia mai outou lava ia te a’u tou te faamaoni i mea uma Ou te poloaiina ai outou, ina ia Ou faamanuiaina outou, ma faapaleina outou i le mamalu, ola pea, ma le ola e faavavau.

verses.en: And now I say unto you, as pertaining to my boarding house which I have commanded you to build for the boarding of strangers, let it be built unto my name, and let my name be named upon it, and let my servant Joseph and his house have place therein, from generation to generation.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e faatatau i lo’u fale talimalo na Ou poloaiina outou ia fausia mo le taliga o tagata ese, ia tuu atu ia fausia i lo’u igoa, ma ia tuu atu lo’u igoa e faaigoa ai, ma ia tuu atu i ai i totonu se mea e nonofo ai la’u auauna o Iosefa ma lona aiga, mai lea tupulaga i lea tupulaga.

verses.en: For this anointing have I put upon his head, that his blessing shall also be put upon the head of his posterity after him.
verses.sm: Aua ua Ou tuuina lenei faauuga i luga o lona ulu, ina ia tuuina foi lona faamanuiaga i luga o ulu o ana fanau mulimuli mai pe a mavae atu o ia.

verses.en: And as I said unto Abraham concerning the kindreds of the earth, even so I say unto my servant Joseph: In thee and in thy seed shall the kindred of the earth be blessed.
verses.sm: Ma e pei ona Ou fai atu ia Aperaamo e faatatau i ituaiga o le lalolagi, e faapea foi ona Ou fai atu i la’u auauna o Iosefa: O le a faamanuiaina ia te oe ma au fanau ituaiga o le lalolagi.

verses.en: Therefore, let my servant Joseph and his seed after him have place in that house, from generation to generation, forever and ever, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: O lea, ia tuu atu ai i la’u auauna o Iosefa ma ana fanau e mulimuli mai pe a mavae atu o ia ia nonofo i lena fale, mai lea tupulaga i lea tupulaga, e faavavau ma faavavau lava, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

verses.en: And let the name of that house be called Nauvoo House; and let it be a delightful habitation for man, and a resting-place for the weary traveler, that he may contemplate the glory of Zion, and the glory of this, the cornerstone thereof;
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu le igoa o lena fale ia ta’ua o le Maota i Navu; ma ia tuu atu ia avea ma malutaga matagofie mo tagata, ma se nofoaga mapu mo le tagata malaga ua vaivai, ina ia mafai e ia ona mafaufau ai i le mamalu o Siona, ma le mamalu o lenei aai, lona maatulimanu;

verses.en: That he may receive also the counsel from those whom I have set to be as plants of renown, and as watchmen upon her walls.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ai foi e ia ona maua le fautuaga mai ia te i latou o e ua Ou faatutuina e avea e pei o ni laau totō lauiloa, ma o ni leoleo i luga o ona pa.

verses.en: Behold, verily I say unto you, let my servant George Miller, and my servant Lyman Wight, and my servant John Snider, and my servant Peter Haws, organize themselves, and appoint one of them to be a president over their quorum for the purpose of building that house.
verses.sm: Faauta, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o George Miller, ma la’u auauna o Lyman Wight, ma la’u auauna o John Snider, ma la’u auauna o Peter Haws, e faatulaga i latou lava, ma tofia se tasi o i latou e avea ma peresitene i luga o la latou korama mo le faamoemoe o le fausiaina o lena fale.

verses.en: And they shall form a constitution, whereby they may receive stock for the building of that house.
verses.sm: Ma ia latou faia se tulafono faavae, e mafai ai ona latou maua ni vaega fa’asoa mo le fausiaina o lena fale.

verses.en: And they shall not receive less than fifty dollars for a share of stock in that house, and they shall be permitted to receive fifteen thousand dollars from any one man for stock in that house.
verses.sm: Ma ia latou lē taliaina se mea maualalo ifo i lo le limasefulu tālā mo se vaega fa’asoa i lena fale, ma ia faatagaina i latou e talia le sefululima afe tālā mai i soo se tagata e toatasi mo vaega fa’asoa o lena fale.

verses.en: But they shall not be permitted to receive over fifteen thousand dollars stock from any one man.
verses.sm: Ae ia lē faatagaina i latou e talia mai i soo se tagata e toatasi le sili atu i le sefululima afe tālā mo se vaega fa’asoa.

verses.en: And they shall not be permitted to receive under fifty dollars for a share of stock from any one man in that house.
verses.sm: Ma ia lē faatagaina i latou e talia mai i soo se tagata e toatasi le itiiti ifo mai i le limasefulu tālā mo se vaega fa’asoa i lena fale.

verses.en: And they shall not be permitted to receive any man, as a stockholder in this house, except the same shall pay his stock into their hands at the time he receives stock;
verses.sm: Ma ia lē faatagaina i latou e talia soo se tagata e avea o se ua i ai vaega fa’asoa i lenei fale, vagana ua totogi mai e lea lava tagata lana vaega i o latou lima i le taimi e maua ai e ia lana fa’asoa;

verses.en: And in proportion to the amount of stock he pays into their hands he shall receive stock in that house; but if he pays nothing into their hands he shall not receive any stock in that house.
verses.sm: Ma o le a maua e ia le vaega fa’asoa i lena fale e tusa ma le aofai o vaega fa’asoa e totogi mai e ia i o latou lima; ae afai e leai se mea e totogi mai e ia i o latou lima o le a lē maua e ia ni vaega fa’asoa i lena fale.

verses.en: And if any pay stock into their hands it shall be for stock in that house, for himself, and for his generation after him, from generation to generation, so long as he and his heirs shall hold that stock, and do not sell or convey the stock away out of their hands by their own free will and act, if you will do my will, saith the Lord your God.
verses.sm: Ma ai se e totogi mai se vaega fa’asoa i o latou lima ia avea ma vaega fa’asoa i lena lava fale, mo ia lava, ma mo ana tupulaga mulimuli mai pe a mavae atu o ia, mai lea tupulaga i lea tupulaga, i le umi e umia ai e ia ma ona suli lena vaega fa’asoa, ma lē faatau atu ai pe tuu ese atu ai le vaega fa’asoa mai i o latou lima i la latou filifiliga saoloto ma mea e fai, pe afai tou te faia lo’u loto, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, if my servant George Miller, and my servant Lyman Wight, and my servant John Snider, and my servant Peter Haws, receive any stock into their hands, in moneys, or in properties wherein they receive the real value of moneys, they shall not appropriate any portion of that stock to any other purpose, only in that house.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, afai e talia e la’u auauna o George Miller, ma la’u auauna o Lyman Wight, ma la’u auauna o John Snider, ma la’u auauna o Peter Haws, soo se vaega fa’asoa i o latou lima, i tupe, po o i meatotino latou te maua ai le aofai moni i tupe, ia latou lē tuu ese soo se vaega o lena fa’asoa mo soo se isi lava faamoemoe, tau lava mo lena fale.

verses.en: And if they do appropriate any portion of that stock anywhere else, only in that house, without the consent of the stockholder, and do not repay four-fold for the stock which they appropriate anywhere else, only in that house, they shall be accursed, and shall be moved out of their place, saith the Lord God; for I, the Lord, am God, and cannot be mocked in any of these things.
verses.sm: Ma afai latou te tuu ese soo se vaega o lena fa’asoa mo soo se isi lava mea, tau lava mo lena fale, e aunoa ma le ioe a le ’au fai fa’asoa, ma latou lē toe totogi mai faa-sautuafā mo le vaega fa’asoa na latou tuu ese mo soo se isi mea, tau lava i lena fale, o le a fetuuina i latou, ma o le a aveesea mai lo latou tulaga, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii le Atua; ona o A’u, le Alii, o le Atua, ma e lē mafai ona ulagia i soo se tasi o ia mea.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, let my servant Joseph pay stock into their hands for the building of that house, as seemeth him good; but my servant Joseph cannot pay over fifteen thousand dollars stock in that house, nor under fifty dollars; neither can any other man, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Iosefa e totogi atu vaega fa’asoa i o latou lima mo le fausiaina o lena fale, pe pei ona talafegai lelei ia te ia; ae e lē mafai e la’u auauna o Iosefa ona totogi e sili atu i le sefululima afe tālā o vaega fa’asoa i lena fale, pe i lalo o le limasefulu tālā; pe mafai foi e se isi lava tagata, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

verses.en: And there are others also who wish to know my will concerning them, for they have asked it at my hands.
verses.sm: Ma o loo i ai foi isi o e ua fia iloa lo’u loto e faatatau ia te i latou, ona ua latou ole mai ai i o’u lima.

verses.en: Therefore, I say unto you concerning my servant Vinson Knight, if he will do my will let him put stock into that house for himself, and for his generation after him, from generation to generation.
verses.sm: O lea, Ou te fai atu ai ia te outou e uiga i la’u auauna o Vinson Knight, afai e fia faia e ia lo’u loto ia tuu atu ia te ia e fai saofaga i lena fale mo ia lava, ma mo ana fanau pe a mavae o ia, mai lea tupulaga i lea tupulaga.

verses.en: And let him lift up his voice long and loud, in the midst of the people, to plead the cause of the poor and the needy; and let him not fail, neither let his heart faint; and I will accept of his offerings, for they shall not be unto me as the offerings of Cain, for he shall be mine, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu ia te ia e siitia a’e i luga lona leo ia umi ma leotele, i totonu o tagata, e aioi le tagi a e matitiva ma lē tagolima; ma ia tuu atu ia te ia ia lē faavaivai, pe ia vaivai lona loto; ma o le a Ou talia ana taulaga, ona o le a lē avea i latou ia te a’u e pei o taulaga a Kaino, aua o le a avea o ia mo a’u, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

verses.en: Let his family rejoice and turn away their hearts from affliction; for I have chosen him and anointed him, and he shall be honored in the midst of his house, for I will forgive all his sins, saith the Lord. Amen.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i lona aiga ia olioli ma liliu ese o latou loto mai puapuaga; ona ua Ou filifilia o ia ma faauuina o ia, ma o le a faamamaluina o ia i totonu o lona aiga, aua o le a Ou faamagaloina ana agasala uma, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii. Amene.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, let my servant Hyrum put stock into that house as seemeth him good, for himself and his generation after him, from generation to generation.
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Ailama ia fai saofaga i lena fale i le mea e talafeagai lelei ia te ia, mo ia lava ma ana fanau pe a mavae atu o ia, mai lea tupulaga i lea tupulaga.

verses.en: Let my servant Isaac Galland put stock into that house; for I, the Lord, love him for the work he hath done, and will forgive all his sins; therefore, let him be remembered for an interest in that house from generation to generation.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Isaac Galland e fai saofaga i lena fale; aua o A’u, o le Alii, ua alofa ia te ia mo galuega na ia faia, ma o le a Ou faamagaloina ana agasala uma; o lea, ia tuu atu ia manatua o ia mo se sao i lena fale mai lea tupulaga i lea tupulaga.

verses.en: Let my servant Isaac Galland be appointed among you, and be ordained by my servant William Marks, and be blessed of him, to go with my servant Hyrum to accomplish the work that my servant Joseph shall point out to them, and they shall be greatly blessed.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Isaac Galland ia tofia i totonu o outou, ma ia faauu e la’u auauna o William Marks, ma faamanuia e ia, e o ma la’u auauna o Ailama e faataunuu le galuega o le a faasino atu e la’u auauna o Iosefa ia te i laua, ma o le a faamanuiaina tele i laua.

verses.en: Let my servant William Marks pay stock into that house, as seemeth him good, for himself and his generation, from generation to generation.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o William Marks e totogi se saofaga i lena fale, e pei ona talafegai lelei ia te ia, mo ia lava ma ana fanau, mai lea tupulaga i lea tupulaga.

verses.en: Let my servant Henry G. Sherwood pay stock into that house, as seemeth him good, for himself and his seed after him, from generation to generation.
verses.sm: Ia tu’u atu i la’u auauna o Enele G. Sherwood e totogi se saofaga i lena fale, e pei ona talafeagai lelei ia te ia, mo ia lava ma lana fanau pe a mavae atu o ia, mai lea tupulaga i lea tupulaga.

verses.en: Let my servant William Law pay stock into that house, for himself and his seed after him, from generation to generation.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o William Law e totogi se saofaga i lena fale, mo ia lava ma lana fanau pe a mavae atu o ia, mai lea tupulaga i lea tupulaga.

verses.en: If he will do my will let him not take his family unto the eastern lands, even unto Kirtland; nevertheless, I, the Lord, will build up Kirtland, but I, the Lord, have a scourge prepared for the inhabitants thereof.
verses.sm: Afai e fia faia e ia lo’u loto ia lē tuu atu ia te ia e ave lona aiga i laueleele i sasa’e, i Katelani lea; ae ui i lea, o A’u, o le Alii, o le a Ou ati a’e i luga Katelani, peitai, o A’u, o le Alii, ua saunia se sasa mo i latou o e o nonofo ai.

verses.en: And with my servant Almon Babbitt, there are many things with which I am not pleased; behold, he aspireth to establish his counsel instead of the counsel which I have ordained, even that of the Presidency of my Church; and he setteth up a golden calf for the worship of my people.
verses.sm: Ma i la’u auauna o Almon Babbit, e tele mea ua Ou lē fiafia ai i ai; faauta, ua saili o ia e faia lana fautuaga nai lo le fautuaga ua Ou faauuina, le fautuaga lava lea a le Au Peresitene o la’u Ekalesia; ma ua faatuina e ia se tamai povi auro e tapuai i ai lo’u nuu.

verses.en: Let no man go from this place who has come here essaying to keep my commandments.
verses.sm: Ia lē tuua se tagata o lē ua sau iinei e saili e tausi i a’u poloaiga, e alu ese atu mai lenei nofoaga.

verses.en: If they live here let them live unto me; and if they die let them die unto me; for they shall rest from all their labors here, and shall continue their works.
verses.sm: Afai latou te ola iinei ia tuu atu ia te i latou ia ola ia te a’u; ma afai e maliliu i latou ia tuu atu ia latou maliliu ia te a’u; auā o le a latou malolo mai ia latou galuega uma iinei, ma o le a faaauau pea a latou galuega.

verses.en: Therefore, let my servant William put his trust in me, and cease to fear concerning his family, because of the sickness of the land. If ye love me, keep my commandments; and the sickness of the land shall redound to your glory.
verses.sm: O lea, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o William ia tuu mai lona faatuatuaga ia te a’u, ma tuu le fefe e faatatau i lona aiga, ona o le faama’i o le laueleele. Afai tou te alolofa mai ia te a’u, tausi i a’u poloaiga; ma o le a liua ai le faama’i o le laueleele mo lo outou mamalu.

verses.en: Let my servant William go and proclaim my everlasting gospel with a loud voice, and with great joy, as he shall be moved upon by my Spirit, unto the inhabitants of Warsaw, and also unto the inhabitants of Carthage, and also unto the inhabitants of Burlington, and also unto the inhabitants of Madison, and await patiently and diligently for further instructions at my general conference, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: Ia tu’u atu i la’u auauna o William e alu ma folafola atu la’u talalelei tumau e faavavau ma le leo tele, ma le olioli tele, e pei ona o le a musuia ai o ia e lo’u Agaga, i e o nonofo i Warsaw, ma e foi o nonofo i Karefasi, ma e foi o nonofo i Burlington, ma e foi o nonofo i Madison, ma faatalitali ma le onosai ma le filiga mo ni isi faatonuga i la’u konafesi aoao, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

verses.en: If he will do my will let him from henceforth hearken to the counsel of my servant Joseph, and with his interest support the cause of the poor, and publish the new translation of my holy word unto the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.sm: Afai e faia e ia lo’u loto ia tuu atu ia te ia ia amata atu nei ona faalogo i le fautuaga a la’u auauna o Iosefa, ma lagolago ma ana mea i le tagi a e matitiva, ma faasalalau atu le faaliliuga fou o la’u upu paia i e o nonofo i le lalolagi.

verses.en: And if he will do this I will bless him with a multiplicity of blessings, that he shall not be forsaken, nor his seed be found begging bread.
verses.sm: Afai e faia e ia lenei mea o le a Ou faamanuiaina o ia i se faatelega o faamanuiaga, o le a lē tuulafoaiina ai o ia, pe maua ai ana fanau i le ’aisi meaai.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, let my servant William be appointed, ordained, and anointed, as counselor unto my servant Joseph, in the room of my servant Hyrum, that my servant Hyrum may take the office of Priesthood and Patriarch, which was appointed unto him by his father, by blessing and also by right;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o William ia tofia, faaee i ai le tofi, ma faauu e avea ma fesoasoani i la’u auauna o Iosefa, i le tulaga o la’u auauna o Ailama, ina ia mafai e la’u auauna o Ailama ona ave o le tofi o le Perisitua ma le Peteriaka, lea na tofia ia te ia e lona tamā, e ala i le faamanuiaga ma i le aiā tatau foi;

verses.en: That from henceforth he shall hold the keys of the patriarchal blessings upon the heads of all my people,
verses.sm: Ina ia umia e ia mai le taimi nei ki o faamanuiaga faapeteriaka i luga o ulu o lo’u nuu uma,

verses.en: That whoever he blesses shall be blessed, and whoever he curses shall be cursed; that whatsoever he shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven; and whatsoever he shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
verses.sm: Ina ia faamanuiaina soo se tasi e faamanuia e ia, ma fetuuina soo se tasi e fetuu e ia; ina ia faamauina i le lagi soo se mea lava e faamauina e ia i le lalolagi; ma o soo se mea lava e tatala e ia i le lalolagi o le a tatalaina i le lagi.

verses.en: And from this time forth I appoint unto him that he may be a prophet, and a seer, and a revelator unto my church, as well as my servant Joseph;
verses.sm: Ma ua Ou tofia o ia mai le taimi nei ia avea o ia o se perofeta, ma se tagatavāai, ma se talifaaaliga i la’u ekalesia, faapea foi la’u auauna o Iosefa;

verses.en: That he may act in concert also with my servant Joseph; and that he shall receive counsel from my servant Joseph, who shall show unto him the keys whereby he may ask and receive, and be crowned with the same blessing, and glory, and honor, and priesthood, and gifts of the priesthood, that once were put upon him that was my servant Oliver Cowdery;
verses.sm: Ina ia galue gatasi foi o ia ma la’u auauna o Iosefa; ma ina ia maua e ia fautuaga mai la’u auauna o Iosefa, o lē o le a ia faaali atu ia te ia ki e mafai ona ole mai ai o ia ma maua ai, ma faapaleina ai i lea lava faamanuiaga, ma le mamalu, ma le viiga, ma le perisitua, ma meaalofa o le perisitua, ia sa tuu atu i se taimi i luga o ia o lē sa avea ma a’u auauna o Oliva Kaotui;

verses.en: That my servant Hyrum may bear record of the things which I shall show unto him, that his name may be had in honorable remembrance from generation to generation, forever and ever.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai e la’u auauna o Ailama ona molimau e uiga i mea o le a Ou faaali atu ia te ia, ina ia manatua lona igoa i le mamalu mai lea tupulaga i lea tupulaga, e faavavau ma faavavau lava.

verses.en: Let my servant William Law also receive the keys by which he may ask and receive blessings; let him be humble before me, and be without guile, and he shall receive of my Spirit, even the Comforter, which shall manifest unto him the truth of all things, and shall give him, in the very hour, what he shall say.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu foi ia maua e la’u auauna o William Law ki e mafai ona ole mai ai o ia ma maua faamanuiaga; ia tuu atu ia te ia ia faamaualalo i o’u luma, ma ia aunoa ma se faa’ole’ole, ma o le a maua e ia lo’u Agaga, o le Fesoasoani lava, lea o le a faaalia atu ia te ia le moni o mea uma, ma tuu atu ia te ia, i le taimi tonu lava, mea e fai atu ai o ia.

verses.en: And these signs shall follow him—he shall heal the sick, he shall cast out devils, and shall be delivered from those who would administer unto him deadly poison;
verses.sm: Ma o faailoga nei e mulimuli atu ia te ia—o le a faamalolo e ia e mama’i, o le a tutuli i fafo e ia tiapolo, ma o le a laveaiina o ia mai ia i latou o e e tuu atu ia te ia mea oona e oti ai;

verses.en: And he shall be led in paths where the poisonous serpent cannot lay hold upon his heel, and he shall mount up in the imagination of his thoughts as upon eagles' wings.
verses.sm: Ma o le a taitaia o ia i ala e lē mafai ai e gata uogo ona utia lona mulivae, ma o le a faatupuina ia te ia manatunatuga o ona mafaufauga e pei ua i luga o apaau o aeto.

verses.en: And what if I will that he should raise the dead, let him not withhold his voice.
verses.sm: Ma afai Ou te loto e faatu mai e ia sē ua oti, ia tuu atu ia te ia ia lē taofia lona leo.

verses.en: Therefore, let my servant William cry aloud and spare not, with joy and rejoicing, and with hosannas to him that sitteth upon the throne forever and ever, saith the Lord your God.
verses.sm: O lea, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o William e alaga leotele atu ma ia lē taofia, i le olioli ma le fiafia, ma osana ia te ia o lē ua afio i luga o le nofoalii e faavavau faavavau lava, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua.

verses.en: Behold, I say unto you, I have a mission in store for my servant William, and my servant Hyrum, and for them alone; and let my servant Joseph tarry at home, for he is needed. The remainder I will show unto you hereafter. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: Faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua ia te a’u se misiona o loo faapolopolo mo la’u auauna o William, ma la’u auauna o Ailama, ma mo na o laua lava; ma ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Iosefa e nofo pea i le aiga, ona ua manaomia o ia. O le vaega o totoe o le a Ou faaali atu ia te outou i se taimi o mulimuli mai. E faapea lava. Amene.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, if my servant Sidney will serve me and be counselor unto my servant Joseph, let him arise and come up and stand in the office of his calling, and humble himself before me.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, afai e fia auauna mai la’u auauna o Sini ia te a’u ma avea ma fesoasoani i la’u auauna o Iosefa, ia tuu atu ia te ia e tulai ma sau i luga ma tu i le tofi o lona valaauga, ma faamaulalo o ia lava i o’u luma.

verses.en: And if he will offer unto me an acceptable offering, and acknowledgments, and remain with my people, behold, I, the Lord your God, will heal him that he shall be healed; and he shall lift up his voice again on the mountains, and be a spokesman before my face.
verses.sm: Ma afai e osi mai e ia ia te a’u se taulaga e talia, ma tautinoga, ma nonofo faatasi pea ma lo’u nuu, faauta, o A’u, o le Alii lo outou Atua, o le a Ou faamaloloina o ia o le a malolo ai o ia; ma o le a toe si’itia a’e e ia lona leo i luga o mauga, ma avea o se failauga i luma o o’u mata.

verses.en: Let him come and locate his family in the neighborhood in which my servant Joseph resides.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu ia te ia e sau ma faatuina lona aiga i le pitonuu lea ua alaala ai la’u auauna o Iosefa.

verses.en: And in all his journeyings let him lift up his voice as with the sound of a trump, and warn the inhabitants of the earth to flee the wrath to come.
verses.sm: Ma i ana malaga uma, ia tuu atu ia te ia e siitia a’e i luga lona leo e pei o le leo o se pu, ma lapatai atu i tagata o le lalolagi ia sosola ese mai le toasa o le a oo mai.

verses.en: Let him assist my servant Joseph, and also let my servant William Law assist my servant Joseph, in making a solemn proclamation unto the kings of the earth, even as I have before said unto you.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu ia te ia e fesoasoani i la’u auauna o Iosefa, ma ia tuu atu foi i la’u auauna o William Law e fesoasoani i la’u auauna o Iosefa, i le faia o se folafolaga aloaia i tupu o le lalolagi, e pei lava ona Ou fai atu ai muamua ia te outou.

verses.en: If my servant Sidney will do my will, let him not remove his family unto the eastern lands, but let him change their habitation, even as I have said.
verses.sm: Afai e fia faia e la’u auauna o Sini lo’u loto, ia lē tuu atu ia te ia e aveese atu lona aiga i laueleele i sasa’e, ae tuu atu ia te ia e sui lo latou nofoaga, e pei lava ona Ou fai atu ai.

verses.en: Behold, it is not my will that he shall seek to find safety and refuge out of the city which I have appointed unto you, even the city of Nauvoo.
verses.sm: Faauta, e lē o lo’u loto le saili e ia ia maua le saogalemu ma le malutaga i fafo atu o le aai lea ua Ou tofia atu ia te outou, o le aai lava lea o Navu.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, even now, if he will hearken unto my voice, it shall be well with him. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e oo i le taimi nei, afai e faalogo mai o ia i lo’u leo, o le a lelei o ia. E faapea lava. Amene.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, let my servant Amos Davies pay stock into the hands of those whom I have appointed to build a house for boarding, even the Nauvoo House.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Amosa Davies e totogi se saofaga i lima o e ua Ou tofia e fausia se fale e tali ai malo, o le Maota lava lea i Navu.

verses.en: This let him do if he will have an interest; and let him hearken unto the counsel of my servant Joseph, and labor with his own hands that he may obtain the confidence of men.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu ia te ia e fai lenei mea pe afai e manao iai; ma ia tuu atu ia te ia e faalogo i le fautuaga a la’u auauna o Iosefa, ma galue i ona lava lima ina ia maua e ia le faatuatuaga o tagata.

verses.en: And when he shall prove himself faithful in all things that shall be entrusted unto his care, yea, even a few things, he shall be made ruler over many;
verses.sm: Ma a faamaonia e ia o ia lava i le faamaoni i mea uma o le a faatuatua atu i lana tausiga, ioe, o mea itiiti lava, o le a avea o ia ma pule i mea e tele;

verses.en: Let him therefore abase himself that he may be exalted. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: O lea ia tuu atu ai ia te ia ia faamaualalo o ia lava ina ia mafai ona faaeaina o ia. E faapea lava. Amene.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, if my servant Robert D. Foster will obey my voice, let him build a house for my servant Joseph, according to the contract which he has made with him, as the door shall be open to him from time to time.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, afai e fia usiusitai la’u auauna o Robert D. Foster i lo’u leo, ia tuu atu ia te ia e fausia se fale mo la’u auauna o Iosefa, e tusa ma le konekarate na faia e ia faatasi ma ia, pe a tatala atu ia te ia le faitotoa mai lea taimi i lea taimi.

verses.en: And let him repent of all his folly, and clothe himself with charity; and cease to do evil, and lay aside all his hard speeches;
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu ia te ia ia salamo mai ona sese uma, ma faaofu o ia lava i le alofa mama; ma tuu le faia o le mea leaga, ma ia faataatitia ese ana upu faatautala mamafa uma;

verses.en: And pay stock also into the hands of the quorum of the Nauvoo House, for himself and for his generation after him, from generation to generation;
verses.sm: Ma ia totogi siea atu foi i lima o le korama o le Maota i Navu, mo ia lava ma ana fanau pe a mavae atu o ia, mai lea tupulaga i lea tupulaga;

verses.en: And hearken unto the counsel of my servants Joseph, and Hyrum, and William Law, and unto the authorities which I have called to lay the foundation of Zion; and it shall be well with him forever and ever. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma faalogo i le fautuaga a a’u auauna o Iosefa, ma Ailama, ma William Law, ma pule ua Ou valaauina e faataatia le faavae o Siona; ma o le a lelei ia te ia e faavavau faavavau lava. E faapea lava. Amene.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, let no man pay stock to the quorum of the Nauvoo House unless he shall be a believer in the Book of Mormon, and the revelations I have given unto you, saith the Lord your God;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia lē tuuina atu i se tagata e totogi siea i le korama o le Maota i Navu vagana ai o ia o se ua talitonu i le Tusi a Mamona, ma faaaliga ua Ou tuu atu ia te outou, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua;

verses.en: For that which is more or less than this cometh of evil, and shall be attended with cursings and not blessings, saith the Lord your God. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: Ona o se mea e faapei o lenei e sau mai le leaga, ma o le a o mai faatasi ma fetuu ae lē o faamanuiaga, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua. E faapea lava. Amene.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, let the quorum of the Nauvoo House have a just recompense of wages for all their labors which they do in building the Nauvoo House; and let their wages be as shall be agreed among themselves, as pertaining to the price thereof.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu i le korama o le Maota i Navu ia maua se totogi tatau ai mo a latou galuega uma ua latou faia i le fausiaina o le Maota i Navu; ma ia tuu atu ia faia o latou totogi e tusa ma le mea latou te malilie i ai i totonu o i latou lava, e tusa ma lona tau talafeagai.

verses.en: And let every man who pays stock bear his proportion of their wages, if it must needs be, for their support, saith the Lord; otherwise, their labors shall be accounted unto them for stock in that house. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i tagata taitoatasi o e e totogi saofaga e ave lana vaega o o latou totogi, pe afai e tatau ai, mo lo latou tausiga, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii; a lē o lea, ia faitauina a latou galuega mo a latou saofaga i lena fale. E faapea lava. Amene.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, I now give unto you the officers belonging to my Priesthood, that ye may hold the keys thereof, even the Priesthood which is after the order of Melchizedek, which is after the order of mine Only Begotten Son.
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, Ou te tuu atu nei ia te outou o e mautofi ua i ai i la’u Perisitua, ina ia mafai ona outou umia ona ki, le Perisitua lava lea e tusa ma le faatulagaga a Mekisateko, lea ua tusa ma le faatulagaga a lo’u Atalii Pele e Toatasi.

verses.en: First, I give unto you Hyrum Smith to be a patriarch unto you, to hold the sealing blessings of my church, even the Holy Spirit of promise, whereby ye are sealed up unto the day of redemption, that ye may not fall notwithstanding the hour of temptation that may come upon you.
verses.sm: Muamua, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou Ailama Samita e avea o se peteriaka mo outou, e umia faamanuiaga faamau o la’u ekalesia, o le Agaga Paia lava o le folafolaga, lea e faamau ai outou mo le aso o le togiolaina, ina ia outou lē pa’u’ū e ui i le itula o le faaosoosoga atonu e oo mai i o outou luga.

verses.en: I give unto you my servant Joseph to be a presiding elder over all my church, to be a translator, a revelator, a seer, and prophet.
verses.sm: Ou te tuu atu ia te outou la’u auauna o Iosefa e avea ma se toeaina pulefaamalumalu i luga o la’u ekalesia atoa, e avea o se faaliliu-upu, o se talifaaaliga, o se tagatavāai, ma se perofeta.

verses.en: I give unto him for counselors my servant Sidney Rigdon and my servant William Law, that these may constitute a quorum and First Presidency, to receive the oracles for the whole church.
verses.sm: Ou te tuu atu ia te ia mo ni fesoasoani o la’u auauna o Sini Rikitone ma la’u auauna o William Law, ina ia avea i latou nei o se korama ma Au Peresitene Sili, e talia faaaliga mo le ekalesia atoa.

verses.en: I give unto you my servant Brigham Young to be a president over the Twelve traveling council;
verses.sm: Ou te tuu atu ia te outou la’u auauna o Brigham Young e avea o se peresitene i luga o le aufono femalagaa’i o le Toasefululua;

verses.en: Which Twelve hold the keys to open up the authority of my kingdom upon the four corners of the earth, and after that to send my word to every creature.
verses.sm: O le Toasefululua lea e umia ki e tatala ai le pule o lo’u malo i luga o tulimanu e fa o le lalolagi, ma a mavae lena e auina atu ai la’u upu i tagata taitoatasi.

verses.en: They are Heber C. Kimball, Parley P. Pratt, Orson Pratt, Orson Hyde, William Smith, John Taylor, John E. Page, Wilford Woodruff, Willard Richards, George A. Smith;
verses.sm: O i latou ia o Heber C. Kimball, Parley P. Pratt, Orson Pratt, Orson Hyde, Viliamu Samita, Ioane Teila, John E. Page, Wilford Woodruff, Willard Richards, Siaosi A. Samita;

verses.en: David Patten I have taken unto myself; behold, his priesthood no man taketh from him; but, verily I say unto you, another may be appointed unto the same calling.
verses.sm: O David Patten ua Ou avea mo a’u lava; faauta, o lona perisitua e leai se tagata e avea mai ia te ia; ae, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e mafai ona tofia se isi i lena lava valaauga.

verses.en: And again, I say unto you, I give unto you a high council, for the cornerstone of Zion—
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se aufono maualuga, mo le maatulimanu o Siona—

verses.en: Namely, Samuel Bent, Henry G. Sherwood, George W. Harris, Charles C. Rich, Thomas Grover, Newel Knight, David Dort, Dunbar Wilson—Seymour Brunson I have taken unto myself; no man taketh his priesthood, but another may be appointed unto the same priesthood in his stead; and verily I say unto you, let my servant Aaron Johnson be ordained unto this calling in his stead—David Fullmer, Alpheus Cutler, William Huntington.
verses.sm: O o latou igoa, o Samuel Bent, Henry G. Sherwood, George W. Harris, Charles C. Rich, Thomas Grover, Newel Knight, David Dort, Dunbar Wilson—o Seymour Brunson ua Ou avea mo a’u lava; e leai se tagata e avea lona perisitua, ae e mafai ona tofia se isi i lea lava perisitua i lona tulaga; ma e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Aaron Ioanesone ia faauu i lenei valaauga i lona tulaga—o David Fullmer, Alpheus Cutler, William Huntington.

verses.en: And again, I give unto you Don C. Smith to be a president over a quorum of high priests;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te tuu ia te outou Don C. Samita e avea o se peresitene i luga o le korama a faitaulaga sili;

verses.en: Which ordinance is instituted for the purpose of qualifying those who shall be appointed standing presidents or servants over different stakes scattered abroad;
verses.sm: O se sauniga lea ua faavaeina mo le faamoemoe o le faaagavaaina o i latou o e o le a tofia e avea ma peresitene nofomau po o ni auauna i luga o siteki eseese ua salalau lautele;

verses.en: And they may travel also if they choose, but rather be ordained for standing presidents; this is the office of their calling, saith the Lord your God.
verses.sm: E mafai foi ona latou malaga atu pe a latou filifili i ai, ae ia faauuina mo peresitene nonofomau; o le tofi lea o lo latou valaauga, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua.

verses.en: I give unto him Amasa Lyman and Noah Packard for counselors, that they may preside over the quorum of high priests of my church, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: Ou te tuu atu ia te ia Amasa Lyman ma Noah Packard mo ni fesoasoani, ina ia latou pulefaamalumalu i luga o le korama a faitaulaga sili o la’u ekalesia, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

verses.en: And again, I say unto you, I give unto you John A. Hicks, Samuel Williams, and Jesse Baker, which priesthood is to preside over the quorum of elders, which quorum is instituted for standing ministers; nevertheless they may travel, yet they are ordained to be standing ministers to my church, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou o John A. Hicks, Samuel Williams, ma Jesse Baker, o le perisitua lea e pulefaamalumalu i luga o le korama a toeaina, o se korama lea ua faatuina mo faifeau nonofomau; ae ui i lea e mafai ona latou malaga, peitai ua faauuina i latou e avea ma faifeau nonofomau i la’u ekalesia, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

verses.en: And again, I give unto you Joseph Young, Josiah Butterfield, Daniel Miles, Henry Herriman, Zera Pulsipher, Levi Hancock, James Foster, to preside over the quorum of seventies;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou o Iosefa Young, Josiah Butterfield, Daniel Miles, Henry Herriman, Zera Pulsipher, Levi Hancock, James Foster, e pulefaamalumalu i luga o le korama a fitugafulu;

verses.en: Which quorum is instituted for traveling elders to bear record of my name in all the world, wherever the traveling high council, mine apostles, shall send them to prepare a way before my face.
verses.sm: O se korama lea ua faatuina mo toeaina femalagaai e molimau atu lo’u igoa i le lalolagi atoa, i soo se mea e auina atu i ai i latou e le aufono maualuga femalagaa’i, o a’u aposetolo ia, e saunia se ala i luma o o’u mata.

verses.en: The difference between this quorum and the quorum of elders is that one is to travel continually, and the other is to preside over the churches from time to time; the one has the responsibility of presiding from time to time, and the other has no responsibility of presiding, saith the Lord your God.
verses.sm: O le eseesega i le va o lenei korama ma le korama a toeaina o le tasi e femalagaa’i e lē aunoa, a’o le isi e pulefaamalumalu i luga o aulotu mai lea taimi i lea taimi; o le tasi ua i ai le tiutetauave o le pulefaamalumalu mai lea taimi i lea taimi, a’o le isi ua leai se tiutetauave ua i ai e pulefaamalumalu ai, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua.

verses.en: And again, I say unto you, I give unto you Vinson Knight, Samuel H. Smith, and Shadrach Roundy, if he will receive it, to preside over the bishopric; a knowledge of said bishopric is given unto you in the book of Doctrine and Covenants.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou Vinson Knight, Samuel H. Samita, ma Shadrach Roundy, pe afai e talia e ia, e pulefaamalumalu i luga o le au epikopo; o se malamalama o lea au epikopo ua ta’ua ua tuu atu ia te outou i le tusi o Mataupu Faavae ma Feagaiga.

verses.en: And again, I say unto you, Samuel Rolfe and his counselors for priests, and the president of the teachers and his counselors, and also the president of the deacons and his counselors, and also the president of the stake and his counselors.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o Samuel Rolfe ma ona fesoasoani mo ositaulaga, ma le peresitene o aoao ma ona fesoasoani, ma le peresitene foi o tiakono ma ona fesoasoani, ma le peresitene foi o le siteki ma ona fesoasoani.

verses.en: The above offices I have given unto you, and the keys thereof, for helps and for governments, for the work of the ministry and the perfecting of my saints.
verses.sm: O tofiga o i luga a’e ua Ou tuu ia te outou, ma o latou ki, mo fesoasoani ma mo pulega, mo le galuega o le auaunaga ma le faaatoatoaina o la’u au paia.

verses.en: And a commandment I give unto you, that you should fill all these offices and approve of those names which I have mentioned, or else disapprove of them at my general conference;
verses.sm: Ma Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga, ia outou faatumuina ia tofiga uma ma pasia igoa na ua Ou tau atu, pe a lē o lea ia lē pasia i latou i la’u konafesi aoao;

verses.en: And that ye should prepare rooms for all these offices in my house when you build it unto my name, saith the Lord your God. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma e tatau ona outou saunia ni potu mo ia tofi i lo’u fale pe a outou fausiaina i lo’u igoa, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua. E faapea lava. Amene.
